taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局公布中秋連假離島加班 1340架次7/27開訂
taiwan_aviation.summary: 交通部民用航空局今日宣布，針對9月25日至28日中秋教師節四天連假，規劃9月24日至29日六天疏運期，澎湖、金門、馬祖三離島航線共提供1340架次、111432個座位，於7月27日上午9時起開放訂位，民航局將視訂位狀況適時增班。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: CAA Taiwan Announces 1,340 Extra Flights for Mid-Autumn Holiday, Booking Opens July 27
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced today that for the four-day Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holiday from September 25 to 28, airlines will operate 1,340 flights with 111,432 seats to the outlying islands of Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu. The transport period runs September 24 to 29. Booking opens July 27 at 9:00 AM, and the CAA will monitor demand to add flights as needed. The breakdown includes 658 flights to Penghu, 522 to Kinmen, and 160 to Matsu.

sources.name: CAA Taiwan — 115年中秋及教師節連假離島管制航線下週一(7/27)上午9時開放訂位

international_aviation.headline: FAA宣布世足賽反無人機行動成果 逾700架無人機被查扣
international_aviation.summary: 美國運輸部長肖恩·杜菲宣布，聯邦、州和地方合作夥伴在2026年國際足聯世界盃期間實施了美國歷史上最全面的空域安全和無人機緩解行動，查獲超過700架無人機，確保數百萬球迷的安全。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA Announces Successful Counter-Drone Efforts at FIFA World Cup 2026, Over 700 Drones Seized
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration has announced that the counter-drone efforts undertaken during the FIFA World Cup 2026 were successful in keeping millions of fans safe, with more than 700 drones seized during the tournament. According to Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy, federal, state, and local partners carried out the most comprehensive airspace security and drone mitigation effort in the history of the United States, demonstrating an unprecedented level of coordination to protect the event.
